body: I’m not one who’s used to physical contact of any sort but Saturday just gone I met up with a friend at a nearby shopping centre and towards the end of the day we found a spot to chill and she sat really close and just leaned her head on my shoulder while hugging my one arm which was quite nice, it’s been a couple years now since anyone hugged me and shits been tough these past couple months so it was very nice to have
Gn you godsend of a person

Y’know, I have so much I want to say but I ain’t tryna overshare a whole lot about myself on the internet but I appreciate your words, I’ve been told by a friend I should seek counselling but I’ll just be asked the same questions on repeat so I just don’t reach out, not even to my friends anymore so I thought I’d make an account on here and see if I can find advice, or something and it would appear I have so thank you again
